2026_04_DEN_SF.headline: Nix and Denver’s secondary challenge Purdy’s unbeaten 49ers in Santa Clara
2026_04_DEN_SF.paragraph1: Bo Nix brings Denver into Santa Clara after consecutive comeback wins, with Sean Payton’s offense needing to stay on schedule against an unbeaten San Francisco team. Brock Purdy threw four touchdowns against Arizona, while George Kittle has helped stabilize a 49ers offense managing injuries around him. Denver’s clearest defensive lever is Pat Surtain II limiting explosive completions and forcing longer drives; San Francisco can answer by protecting Purdy and distributing the ball before Denver’s rush can dictate the down.
2026_04_DEN_SF.model_rationale: Denver needs efficient early downs and disciplined coverage to keep San Francisco from controlling tempo, while the 49ers can stress the Broncos by protecting Purdy and spreading targets.
